description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's merge-recursive functionality, especially focusing on rename detection, thresholds, and conflict resolution scenarios. It sets up a test repository, defines various test functions, and runs multiple test cases involving different rename detection configurations.

methods.name: get_expected_stages
methods.description: Prepares and stores expected stages for rename detection tests based on the current branch state.

methods.name: rename_detected
methods.description: Checks that renames are detected as expected for a given file index.

methods.name: rename_undetected
methods.description: Checks that renames are not detected for a given file index.

methods.name: check_common
methods.description: Verifies the total number of staged files matches expectations.

methods.name: check_threshold_0
methods.description: Verifies rename detection with a low similarity threshold.

methods.name: check_threshold_1
methods.description: Verifies rename detection with a medium similarity threshold.

methods.name: check_threshold_2
methods.description: Verifies rename detection with a high similarity threshold.

methods.name: check_exact_renames
methods.description: Verifies that only exact renames are detected (100% similarity).

methods.name: check_no_renames
methods.description: Verifies that no renames are detected.
